mcp._comment: TCP listener for standard MCP clients (Claude Code). port 0 disables it, leaving the unix socket. Overridden by CHATMUX_MCP_PORT / CHATMUX_MCP_HOST.
mcp._comment_host: Defaults to 127.0.0.1. Change it only when something outside this machine's loopback must reach the daemon (a container, mainly) — this listener has no authentication, and any non-loopback value warns at startup. See docs/mcp-interface.md.
